declare
 cur_itm varchar2(80) ;
begin
if :alert_log.read_date is null then
 :alert_log.msg_status := 'NEW' ;
 Display_Item( 'MSG_STATUS', 'UNREAD_MESSAGE'); 
 -- Display_Item( 'MSG_STATUS', 'READ_MESSAGE'); 
else
 :alert_log.msg_status := 'OLD' ;
 Display_Item( 'MSG_STATUS', 'READ_MESSAGE'); 
end if ;

begin
 select msg_text, b.insert_user, substr(initcap(rtrim(user_last_name))||','||initcap(rtrim(user_first_name)),1,30)
 into :alert_log.text, :alert_log.insert_user,:alert_log.user_name
 from alert_messages b,system_users a
 where msg_id = :alert_log.msg_id
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and a.user_id=b.insert_user;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :alert_log.text := 'Alert message not found in database' ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
end ;
end ;


Declare
 v_local_time date;--timestamp;
 v_local_time1 date;
Begin
 
 /* Convert GMT hh:mi into local time hh:mi for inserst_date*/
 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:alert_log.insert_date,v_local_time);
 
 :alert_log.ctrl_insert_date :=v_local_time;
 
 else
 :alert_log.ctrl_insert_date:= :alert_log.insert_date;
 
 end if;
 
 if :alert_log.read_date is not null then
 
 /* Convert GMT hh:mi into local time hh:mi for read_date*/ 
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:alert_log.read_date,v_local_time1);
 
 :alert_log.ctrl_read_date :=v_local_time1;
 
 
 else
 :alert_log.ctrl_read_date:= :alert_log.read_date;
 
 end if;
 end if; 
end;

declare
 cur_itm varchar2(80) ;
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_local_time date;
 v_time_of_day date;
 v_insert_timeofday date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
go_block('alert_log') ;
 
if :read_date is null then

 -- :read_date := sysdate ;
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date :=v_local_time;
 else

 end if;

 :system.message_level := 10;

 :alert_log.ctrl_read_date :=v_local_time;
 else

 end if;
end if; 
hide_view('canvas_msgtext');
end ;

-- Modified and verified for Y2K.....Jodi...6/99
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 msg_count number ;
BEGIN
 -- :global.program_version := '1.01.01' ;
 -- :global.program_version := '2.03.00' ;
 -- :global.program_version := '3.01.00' ;
 -- :global.program_version := '02'; --Add timezone
 -- :global.program_version := '03'; -- IM 5332
 -- :global.program_version := '04'; -- IM 5332
 -- :global.program_version := '05'; -- IM:8497
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 --:global.program_version := '01';
 :global.program_version := '02'; -- IM 646 
 
 
 default_value(' ','global.time_zone_enabled'); 
 
 --:global.chapter_id := 'WAD'; -- IM 646
 
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 :global.time_zone_enabled:='Y';
 else
 :global.time_zone_enabled:='N';
 end if;

 execute_trigger('util_banner') ;
 disable_toolbar_initial ;

 begin
 select count(*) into msg_count
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and remove_date is null ;
 
 exception
 when others then 
 
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 if msg_count = 0 then
 
 show_error('11277') ;
 exit_form(NO_VALIDATE) ;
 else
 go_block('alert_log') ;
 execute_query ;
 go_item('alert_log.text');
 end if ;
END;
